nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_000
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What is the typical breeding success rate in lowland Wheatear populations?
nodes.answer: In lowland populations, successful broods occur regularly in less than half of the breeding pairs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_001
nodes.label: Ecology
nodes.question: How did replacement broods compare to initial broods in terms of breeding success?
nodes.answer: Replacement broods had a higher breeding success compared to initial broods within the same breeding season.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How many generations per year does Lycaena tityrus typically have in most parts of its range?
nodes.answer: Lycaena tityrus typically has 2 to 3 generations per year in most parts of its range.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What have recent spatio-genetic studies indicated about M. giganteus populations in South-East Queensland?
nodes.answer: Recent studies have indicated that M. giganteus populations in this area have unique genetic characteristics.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_004
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What method was used to assess the breeding phases in 2023?
nodes.answer: The breeding phases in 2023 were assessed through direct field observations.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why are wild colonies of European honey bees becoming rare?
nodes.answer: Wild colonies of European honey bees are becoming rare due to the introgression of managed and feral colonies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_006
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of the breeding range was permanently deforested before the year 2000?
nodes.answer: More than 37% of the breeding range was permanently deforested prior to the year 2000.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate biodiversity resiliance|Conservation breeding programs_qna_007
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What types of CNVRs were identified in the cattle?
nodes.answer: The CNVRs were categorized into three types: deletion, duplication, and both.
